title: MULTIVOX: A Benchmark for Evaluating Voice Assistants for Multimodal Interactions

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing model inferences of a speaker's biological gender from speech cues to check for skewed preferences toward male or female identities, or an over-reliance on visual/textual context rather than the actual audio characteristics.

Evaluating model inferences of a speaker's age group from speech cues to identify skewed response patterns, such as models overwhelmingly favoring 'young-to-middle-aged adult' regardless of the speaker's actual age.
